Bron: 21 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.

Bron: posters_297x420_3_1.pdf p1 (RGB (ICC sRGB); bleed box in bron ja). Template: trim 297 x 420 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 303 x 426 mm.

Variabelen: headline = Let op!; sentence-start = Op; location-name = locatie; sentence-1-end = is het; sentence-line-2 = niet mogelijk om op deze; sentence-line-3 = locatie te parkeren.; contact-heading = Storing?; contact-phone = Bel 085 4011647; contact-text = en wij lossen het zo snel mogelijk op; url = www.parkingyou.nl

A3 297 x 420 mm, the source has the 3 mm bleed (page 303 x 426) and a TrimBox. REBUILT because the large pale bubble in the background is a raster in the source: it is rebuilt as a vector, the silhouette of the beeldmerk (shape of py-atom-logo-beeldmerk-watermark) scaled by 6.069 with the top left at 111.35 / 20.25 mm (page mm), cut at the right

edge of the page. Fitted to the raster mask (overlap 99.98 percent, so the print bubble is the beeldmerk bubble, uniformly scaled to a 329.6 mm circle). Colour: the raster is flat #F5F6F9 in its palette and renders as #F7F8FA; the reference uses the rendered value, the template draws the navy token #1A3580 at 3.5 percent (same result, a tint as in

observed rule 8; the library watermark is aqua at 5 percent and would look different). Library: py-comp-lockup-logo-tagline-color at scale 1.125 (118.0 mm wide), py-atom-icon-warning-triangle at 87.0 mm wide, recoloured to the light aqua sample #83CBE1 (no token, kept as sampled; the library triangle uses #71CBDF).
